name: krasker_29_marked_touch_child
why: Corrected child of krasker-29. Its supplied exit logic halves the marked bid for signal/stop closes and substitutes a penny for timed closes, consistent with the audit's 48.15%-50% limit-deviation refusals. Close at the marked touch instead, preserving credit buyback conversion, entry selection, exit triggers, parameters, Alpaca options specialty, daily horizon and five underlyings. Starts at rung 0 and must qualify on its own evidence; CI and paper refusal records judge the repair.
